habitat: Warm oceans, coral reefs, and sandy beaches.
diet: Sea grass, jellyfish, algae, and small sea creatures.
fun_facts: Sea turtles can travel very long distances through the ocean.
Baby sea turtles hatch from eggs buried in warm sand.
Some sea turtles can hold their breath for several hours while resting.
short_story: Tilly the sea turtle woke up beside a bright coral reef. She stretched her flippers, waved to a passing fish, and began her slow swim toward breakfast.
